platforms.name: LeetCode
platforms.bestFor: Timed DSA practice, company-tagged mediums, and contest pressure.

platforms.name: Pramp
platforms.bestFor: Free peer mock interviews with structured feedback rotations.

platforms.name: interviewing.io
platforms.bestFor: Anonymous mocks with experienced engineers and detailed rubrics.

platforms.name: Exponent
platforms.bestFor: System design and behavioral courses with sample interview videos.

platforms.name: Hello Interview
platforms.bestFor: Structured system design frameworks and mock interviews.

platforms.name: NeetCode
platforms.bestFor: Pattern-organized problem lists and video explanations after your attempt.

platforms.name: CodeSignal
platforms.bestFor: Proctored-style coding assessments and arcade practice modes.

items.title: Weekly mock: foundations coding set
items.instructions: Saturday mock: two problems in 70 minutes (35 each), then a 20-minute retro. The plan supplies the two problems for the week. No AI during the mock.
coverChecklist: Write retro: time lost, bug class

items.title: Retention check: arrays & hash map
items.instructions: Timed recall on arrays and hashing: two problems at 12 minutes each, from the week's set. Attempt without AI; read an editorial only after both submissions.
coverChecklist: Run at least two custom tests

items.title: Weekly mock: stacks & queues
items.instructions: Timed stack set from the week's problems: two problems, 35 minutes each, then a 20-minute retro. Draw the stack contents for one input by hand.

items.title: Fundamentals check: OS processes
items.instructions: Answer fund001–fund003 self-check questions in writing without notes; grade yourself honestly.

items.title: Weekly mock: trees
items.instructions: Timed tree set from the week's problems: one traversal warm-up, then two mediums at 30 minutes each. Write one recursive and one iterative solution.

items.title: Retention check: two pointers
items.instructions: Timed recall on two pointers: one easy then one medium from the week's set, 15 minutes each. State the pointer invariant out loud before coding.

items.title: Weekly mock: graphs onsite pair
items.instructions: Onsite-style graph pair from the week's problems: two problems, 45 minutes each, narrated aloud end to end. Score yourself on whether you named the algorithm before coding.

items.title: Retention check: sliding window
items.instructions: Timed recall on sliding window: one fixed-size and one variable-size window problem from the week's set, 17 minutes each. Say which variant you are using before coding.

items.title: Communication check: coding opener
items.instructions: Record com001 practice prompt once; listen back for filler words. No AI script.

items.title: Weekly mock: mixed mediums
items.instructions: Saturday LeetCode weekly contest or self-scheduled: any two mediums you have not solved. Strict 45+45 timing.

items.title: Networking check: DNS trace
items.instructions: Answer net001 checklist from memory; run dig +trace on a domain locally and compare to your trace.

items.title: Weekly mock: peer coding
items.instructions: Book Pramp or interviewing.io session; solve one medium with full communication scoring.

items.title: Networking check: TLS & timeouts
items.instructions: Explain net005 and net011 checklists in a 5-minute recording. Attempt solo first.

items.title: Weekly mock: DP fundamentals
items.instructions: Timed DP set from the week's problems: two problems, 45 minutes each. For each, write state, transition and base case before any code.

items.title: Fundamentals check: ACID & isolation
items.instructions: Write answers to fund009 and fund010 self-check questions; relate to Go go030 transaction exercise.

items.title: Weekly mock: intervals and greedy set
items.instructions: Two problems in 70 minutes (35 each) on intervals and greedy, then a 20-minute retro. No AI during the mock. Score yourself on whether you named the pattern before coding.
coverChecklist: Name the pattern in the first two minutes
State the sort key and why
Write the retro before checking a solution

items.title: Retention check: binary search
items.instructions: Timed recall on binary search: two problems from the week's set, 15 minutes each. Write the loop invariant as a comment before the loop.

items.title: System design mock: rate limiter
items.instructions: 45-minute timed sd010 HLD on paper; then 15 min compare to notes. No AI during timer.

items.title: Retention check: intervals
items.instructions: Timed recall on intervals: two problems from the week's set, 17 minutes each. State the sort key and the merge condition first.

items.title: System design: news feed
items.instructions: Full sd011 session with fan-out math. Record audio. Review without AI first pass on rubric.

items.title: Retention check: heap
items.instructions: Timed recall on heaps and top-K: two problems from the week's set, 17 minutes each. Justify heap vs sort vs quickselect out loud.

items.title: System design: chat
items.instructions: sd012 with WebSocket scaling focus. Draw sequence diagram send message → deliver.

items.title: Go check: goroutines intro
items.instructions: Complete go011 practice prompt; run with -race. Attempt without AI first.

items.title: System design: notifications
items.instructions: sd013 full pass with idempotency and DLQ. Compare to checklist only after.

items.title: Retention check: backtracking intro
items.instructions: Timed recall on backtracking: one problem from the week's set in 40 minutes. Draw the decision tree for a size-3 input before coding.

items.title: System design: autocomplete
items.instructions: sd015 with latency budget p99 < 100ms. Attempt solo; then watch one Exponent clip for missing pieces only.

items.title: Retention check: BFS template
items.instructions: Timed recall on graph traversal: one problem from the week's set in 35 minutes. State the representation and why before you write the loop.

items.title: Weekly mock: Google-ish set
items.instructions: Pick two Google-tagged LeetCode mediums you have not seen; 50 min each with break. Full think-aloud.

items.title: Go check: SQL transactions
items.instructions: Implement go030 transfer exercise with sqlite in-memory. Attempt without AI.

items.title: Weekly mock: behavioral + coding
items.instructions: 30 min behavioral (com013–com016) recorded answers; 60 min one hard LeetCode attempt.

items.title: Retention check: union find
items.instructions: Timed recall on union-find: one problem from the week's set in 35 minutes, with path compression written from memory.

items.title: Go capstone: mini service
items.instructions: Weekend build: HTTP API with middleware, slog, sqlite, Docker per go032–go034. Attempt without AI codegen.

items.title: Go check: HTTP middleware
items.instructions: Build go026 middleware chain with httptest coverage. No AI until tests written.

items.title: Mock: code comprehension round (2026 pilot format)
items.instructions: Simulate Google's 2026 code-comprehension round. Take a 200–500 line Go repo you have never read. 60 minutes: orient, find a real bug, fix it, propose one improvement — with an AI assistant allowed, and every claim verified aloud. 30-minute retro on your prompts and verifications.
coverChecklist: Every assistant claim verified against the code
One ranked improvement with the failure it prevents

items.title: Retention check: DP state transitions
items.instructions: Write the state, transition and base case for four DP problems in 25 minutes — definitions only, no full implementations.
coverChecklist: Base case and answer cell identified

items.title: Weekly mock: coding pair plus design follow-up
items.instructions: One 45-minute coding round with a peer, then a 30-minute design follow-up on the same domain. 15-minute retro. Swap interviewer roles if pairing.
coverChecklist: Retro lists one behaviour to change

items.title: LLD check: LRU cache
items.instructions: sd019 timed implementation. Go or Java. No AI until 25 minutes elapsed.

items.title: Full loop simulation: three coding rounds plus Googleyness
items.instructions: Back-to-back simulation in one sitting: three 45-minute coding rounds with short breaks, then a 45-minute Googleyness round. Score each round independently, as a real loop does.
coverChecklist: Four STAR-L stories delivered in under three minutes each
Write the packet you think the interviewers would file

items.title: System design check: URL shortener
items.instructions: Attempt sd009 practice prompt fully before watching any video. Then skim Hello Interview outline for gaps only.

items.title: Retention check: bit manipulation and greedy
items.instructions: Timed recall sweep: two bit-manipulation problems in 25 minutes. Tag every miss by pattern, not by problem.
coverChecklist: State the bit trick before coding

items.title: Weekly mock: onsite simulation
items.instructions: Saturday onsite sim: 2 coding (45+45), 1 system design (45), 2 behavioral (20 each). Breaks 10 min between. No AI.

items.title: Retention check: graphs and union-find
items.instructions: Two graph problems from memory in 25 minutes — one traversal, one union-find. Write the template from scratch, no copy-paste.
coverChecklist: Write union-find with path compression from memory

items.title: Final weekly mock: confidence calibration
items.instructions: Final Saturday mock: one fresh medium, one design you know well (15 min recap only), one behavioral. Rest Sunday.

items.title: STAR story draft
items.instructions: Complete com008 and com010 written drafts. Attempt without AI; polish once.

items.title: Retention check: trie
items.instructions: Timed recall on tries: build the structure from memory and solve one problem from the week's set in 35 minutes.

items.title: Polish: light retention set
items.instructions: Two problems you solved before—must re-code from memory without hints. Focus fluency not new patterns.

items.title: CodeSignal arcade sprint
items.instructions: Complete 3 CodeSignal arcade tasks focusing on clean implementation speed.

items.title: Networking check: request trace
items.instructions: Deliver net025 90-second trace for your own project's API. Attempt without slides.

items.title: Go check: context & shutdown
items.instructions: Combine go014 and go028 into a small server that cancels work on shutdown. Attempt without AI.
coverChecklist: In-flight request completes or aborts cleanly

items.title: Weak area sprint assessment
items.instructions: From prior mocks, pick weakest tag; solve 3 problems of that tag timed easy→medium→medium.

items.title: Go check: maps and table tests
items.instructions: Go check: write a map-based frequency counter and its table-driven test from scratch, no AI, no copy-paste from earlier work.

items.title: Final calibration: pattern recall sweep
items.instructions: No new problems. For each of the 26 patterns, write from memory: when to use it, the invariant, and one problem that uses it. Anything blank is your only remaining study list.
coverChecklist: Blank entries turned into a short final list
Stop studying after this — rest is the last variable
